profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer @ Tekscend Photomasks, Inc. | Certified Scrum Developer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Toppan Photomasks, I design and develop desktop and web-based applications using Java and Spring Boot. I apply my Certified Scrum Developer® (CSD®) skills to participate in agile project management, including daily stand-ups and bi-weekly sprint meetings.

I graduated from the University of Dayton with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems in 2019. During my studies, I gained valuable experience as a Software Development Intern at Hyland for over four years, where I worked on various projects using Angular 10, C#, and SQL. I also learned to communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders, and to collaborate with cross-functional teams. My goal is to continue learning and growing as a full-stack software engineer, and to contribute to the success and innovation of Tekscend Photomasks.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Increased efficiency by 30% and eliminated the risk for human error by converting a legacy PERL program to a Java Object-Oriented application used in 100% of production jobs.
• Trained all pilot-phase end users (25+) through user workflows for 3 applications, and taught the training process for supervisors to expand to more users on full release.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Individually developed a generalized Java Application that parsed, analyzed, and formatted delimited files that is used on log data from all types of tools across the factory.
• Implemented agile practices and workflows for a start-up software development team
• Presented and regularly demonstrated concept designs, prototypes, and releases to stakeholders and customers for our entire team, even when not personally on the application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on internal python scripting for automation of collection and testing of data
• Maintained Oracle SQL servers containing both sensitive and non-sensitive data
• Managed data collection and validation with upwards of 600K daily entries
• Worked with a team to build an up-to-date Angular 11 training course for GM Development
positions.insights: Oracle SQL Developer, Python (Programming Language) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Participated in Agile Project Management, including daily stand-ups and bi-weekly sprint meetings
•	Helped integrate Jira/Git into the development and commitment flow
•	Refactored and improved existing code, while teaching better coding practices to co-workers
•	Worked daily in Angular and C# on web applications and backend code that ships to customers

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked alongside full-time employees on software released and sold to customers
•	Developed multiple stand-alone applications used for internal testing and development 
•	Played a lead role in building the OWIN foundation for web development
•	Took a leadership role on multiple internship teams leading development solutions that have gone out internally and to customers
